description: This file defines a generic hash table implementation in C, including macros for creating hash tables, functions for managing hash table memory, and hash functions for specific key types like strings and object IDs.

methods.name: kh_init_oid_set
methods.description: Initializes a hash set for object IDs.

methods.name: kh_destroy_oid_set
methods.description: Destroys a hash set for object IDs and frees memory.

methods.name: kh_clear_oid_set
methods.description: Clears all entries in the object ID hash set.

methods.name: kh_get_oid_set
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an object ID in the hash set.

methods.name: kh_resize_oid_set
methods.description: Resizes the object ID hash set.

methods.name: kh_put_oid_set
methods.description: Inserts an object ID into the hash set.

methods.name: kh_del_oid_set
methods.description: Deletes an object ID from the hash set.
